flow_magnitude — REPRCONV flow op

• Data kinds: flow_dense → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.flow_magnitude(flow) (to call the implementation directly, import reprconv; reprconv.flow_magnitude(flow); from the registry, opsreprconv.get("flow_magnitude"))

Usage

Dense scene flow (3,D,H,W) → a speed volume voxel (D,H,W). The exit from flow.

sqrt(dz^2 + dy^2 + dx^2). One-way (the direction is discarded, so it cannot be inverted). What is discarded can be stated explicitly: of the 3 components, the direction worth 2 degrees of freedom disappears, and only the magnitude remains. To see the direction as well, use flow_to_rgbimage.

Args:

flow: (3, D, H, W). Component order is (dz, dy, dx) (the scene_flow_lk convention).

Returns:

(D, H, W) float64.

Raises:

ValueError: not a dense flow / non-finite.
